description: The chart illustrates Shapley values for a set of morphosyntactic feature categories, shown as a grouped bar chart comparing three models. The category axis is horizontal and lists feature labels in order from left to right as L3, L2, L1, T, R1, R2, R3, and R4+ (as displayed on the x-axis). The value axis is labeled “Shapley value” and uses a linear scale with labeled ticks at approximately 0, 20, 40, 60, and 80, spanning roughly 0 to a bit above 80. For each category, three adjacent bars are shown, corresponding to the legend entries (light blue for XLM, darker blue for XLM-R, and light green for chLSTM), arranged side-by-side within each group. Approximate bar heights are: for L3, small values around ~5 (XLM), ~7 (XLM-R), and ~0–1 (chLSTM); for L2, near ~1 (XLM), ~3 (XLM-R), and ~0–1 (chLSTM); for L1, around ~12 (XLM), ~15 (XLM-R), and ~2 (chLSTM); for T, the tallest group with about ~80 (XLM), ~75 (XLM-R), and ~90 (chLSTM); for R1, mid-range values around ~30 (XLM), ~35 (XLM-R), and ~33 (chLSTM); for R2, around ~25 (XLM), ~27 (XLM-R), and ~22 (chLSTM); for R3, low values around ~2–4 across the three bars; and for R4+, higher values around ~40 (XLM), ~45 (XLM-R), and ~38–40 (chLSTM). The bars do not appear to be sorted by height; no individual bars are visually emphasized beyond the color coding and the legend.
